tooltips.iconLucideSlug: The slug is the icon's name in the Lucide icon library. You can find the full list of icons on their website. (Icon picker coming soon)
tooltips.iconSimpleSlug: The slug is the icon's name in the Simple icon library. You can find the full list of icons on their website. (Icon picker coming soon)
tooltips.iconTypeLucide: Library of free, open-source icons. Has a lot of icons for various use cases.
tooltips.colorContrast: Increases the contrast of the shadows and highlights of the folder.
tooltips.colorHueShift: Shifts the color (hue) of the folder gradually to give a natural, vibrant look.
tooltips.debugMode: Replaces the changelog button with the debug menu. Useful for troubleshooting and hacking around. Not recommended for regular use.
tooltips.unsavedWarning: Will give a warning if you try to close the window or navigate away from the folder without saving changes. Can get annoying if you don't save frequently.
